evidence: Trimethylaluminum (Me3Al) from SAFC Hitech with electronic grade and deionized water (H2O) were used as the precursors for the Al2O3 film. The precursor dose and purge times were 0.1 and 4.0 s, respectively. For some samples grown at 300 °C, a faster, optimized recipe was used, where the dose and purge sequence for precursors was (0.1-1.0-0.1-1.0) s. The intermediate space pressure was about 7 hPa and there was a constant 200 sccm nitrogen (purity N 99.999%) flow through reactant lines.
